gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-chocolate-cla: Chocolate Classical Sans writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. Nasalization above it is all uniform lines, none of them thickening or thinning, so give the sans body a little extra size to match its sizable lowercase.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-comme: Smooth and unclogged, with lowercase that fills most of the letter height. Comme is the body that makes this pair work, since its curves stay open beside Nasalization's stylus-at-fixed-pressure lines.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-cossette-text: Nasalization leads with short ascenders and a big lowercase, its letters floating well apart. And Cossette Texte follows with wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height, so the sans body feels friendly under the display lines.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans opens its small letters wide, and the bodies dominate each line. Ascenders hardly show, so a long page moves along smoothly, while Nasalization's heading keeps its single-gauge curves up top.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-fresca: Nasalization's c opens like a pair of calipers. Shrink that heading and its floating letters lose their presence, whereas Fresca, a plain sans with connected counters and no calligraphic thinning, copes well at larger sizes.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line, with strokes that hold their width from stem to curve. Its e opens like a pried clasp, so a long passage runs smoothly.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-gafata: Every stem and curve in Nasalization looks cut from one gauge of tubing, and the letters float apart. And Gafata brings a tall band of lowercase with short stalks above, so giving the sans body a bit more size suits it.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-geist: Nasalization starts things off with short ascenders, a big lowercase and a c opened like calipers. Geist follows with a quiet, level beat, its words reading as solid blocks rather than skylines.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-georama: Georama reads wide open, its c like a bracelet pulled apart, with capitals that barely rise. Georama is the plain sans that lets Nasalization's round bowls, never swelling or tapering, stay the star.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-gidole: Nasalization floats its big lowercase letters apart, with short ascenders and calipers-style c shapes. Gidole answers with neon-tube consistency in every stroke and a high-set midline, so a slightly larger size suits the sans-serif body.
